title: Day.js
description: A minimalist JavaScript library for parsing, validating, and formatting dates.

data.text: Day.js is a fast, lightweight alternative to Moment.js. It offers a similar API for parsing, manipulating, and formatting dates, but with a much smaller footprint.

data.title: Installation
data.code:
npm install dayjs
# or
yarn add dayjs

data.title: Basic Usage
data.content: Parse and format dates with Day.js.

terms.definition: Day.js objects are immutable; methods return new instances.
Extend Day.js with features like timezone support and relative time.

data.title: Key Takeaways
data.takeaway: Day.js is the modern replacement for Moment.js in lightweight applications.
